name: Together Tev1

based_on.note: Fine-tuned from Qwen3.5 (4B and 0.8B), per the Ollama page.

summary: Experimental decision models from Together AI in 4B and 0.8B sizes, aimed at Jev-style routing and policy checks. Decision model: it answers typed questions (yes/no, choice, score) with probabilities through a Jev-compatible /v1/systemone endpoint. It does not chat or write text.

practical_baseline.reason: Decision models are not ranked by the chat-model baseline policy; pick by hardware and API.
